title: Tracking scope and change requests
summary: Document project deliverables and share changes for client review.
excerpts: Use the Scope tab to list deliverables, revision limits, and due dates. Publish the agreed scope to the client portal so both sides can see the same version.
When a client asks for extra work, add a change request with the proposed impact on cost and timing. Share it through the portal for approval before you update the agreed scope.
